titleCard.headline: 给导航起对名字
titleCard.lede: 「做个导航栏」只说了有一排链接。先定它住在哪、怎么打开、滚的时候干什么。

closeCard.headline: 说清楚
closeCard.lede: 最容易混的三对：抽屉不是全屏，下拉不是巨型，收缩不是吸顶。先说名称、场景和规则，再谈外观。

titleCard.headline: Name the nav
titleCard.lede: “Make a navbar” only says there is a row of links. First decide where it lives, how it opens, and what scroll does.

closeCard.headline: Say it this way
closeCard.lede: The three pairs people mix up: a drawer is not a full-screen overlay; a dropdown is not a mega; shrink is not sticky. Name it, name the scene, name the rule.

lines.zh: 给导航起对名字。「做个导航栏」只说了有一排链接。先定它住在哪、怎么打开、滚的时候干什么。
lines.en: Name the nav. “Make a navbar” only says there is a row of links. First decide where it lives, how it opens, and what scroll does.

lines.zh: 悬浮吸顶是离顶的浮卡，用 sticky 钉住，不要用 fixed。
lines.en: Floating sticky is an inset card pinned with sticky, not fixed.

lines.zh: 侧栏是竖排主导航，长期占位，可折成图标。
lines.en: A sidebar is vertical primary nav. It occupies, and may collapse to icons.

lines.zh: 面包屑是路径，不是主导航。最后一项是当前页，不能再点。
lines.en: A breadcrumb is a path, not the primary nav. The last item is the page.

lines.zh: 站点二级下拉是栏目下的一列子页，不是表单。
lines.en: A site dropdown is one column of children, not a form field.

lines.zh: 巨型菜单是整宽多列分类，不是一行子链。
lines.en: A mega menu is classified columns, not one child list.

lines.zh: 汉堡抽屉是小屏主导航，从侧边滑入并锁滚动。
lines.en: A hamburger drawer is small-screen primary. It slides in and locks scroll.

lines.zh: 全屏遮罩把整页换成菜单，不是一条边。
lines.en: A full-screen overlay replaces the page. It is not an edge panel.

lines.zh: 锚点导航滚到哪高亮哪。点击跳转时先锁观察器。
lines.en: Scrollspy highlights the section in view. Lock the observer on a click jump.

lines.zh: 滚动收缩改的是顶栏自己的高度和对比度，不是钉住的位置。
lines.en: Shrink changes the bar itself, not where it pins.

lines.zh: 最容易混的三对：抽屉不是全屏，下拉不是巨型，收缩不是吸顶。先说名称、场景和规则，再谈外观。
lines.en: The three pairs people mix up: a drawer is not a full-screen overlay; a dropdown is not a mega; shrink is not sticky. Name it, name the scene, name the rule.
